content.value: An urn always contains 4 balls. The ball colors are red and blue. We can say that the State i,  = 0.1.2.3.4, if the urn contains i red balls. At each stage, a ball Randomly chosen and then replaced by new ball, which with a probability of 0.7 is the same color. and with a probability of 0.3 is the opposite color, as the ball it replaces. Find its transition probability matrix with detailed calculation.
